coordinates: normalised image coordinates: x from the left edge and y from the top edge, both 0 to 1; a box is [x0, y0, x1, y1] with x1 > x0 and y1 > y0
note: Drawn by eye on the plate frame for the M0.5 backtest pair (PRD §16 M0.5), as stand-ins for landmark projections. They are not surveyed and not in the viewpoint manifest. The M2 pose solve (PRD §8.5) projects surveyed landmarks and replaces them (TODO(M2)).

boxes.name: north-rim-cliffs
boxes.what: The upper cliff band of the far (North) rim on the left half of the frame, just below its skyline. Distance not surveyed; the canyon is roughly 15-20 km rim to rim here.

boxes.name: mid-canyon
boxes.what: Buttes and temples inside the canyon, below the far rim. Nearer than the far rim; distance not surveyed.

notes: Each box lies inside one band of terrain, with no sky, so that it holds the same kind of terrain in a frame whose aim differs by a few per cent. The 2024-01-15 19:45Z hires is shifted by about +51 px (x) and -30 px (y) against this plate at the same scale (phase correlation of gradient images, lookout_eval.registration); both boxes stay inside their bands under that shift.
The far-rim skyline itself (sky above rock) is deliberately not boxed: a vertical shift of a few per cent changes how much sky such a box holds, and with it the edge energy.
